title: AC1018 physical TABLE direct-codec refusal boundary

source.provenance: Audited ODA 27.1 conversion of a previously documented AC1027 DXF source; source is outside the repository.

observations.wholeImport: 226/226 source frames published; zero entity/object parse failures; one TABLE at handle 0x9c.
observations.directEncode: The ordinary DRW_Table::encodeDwg overload refuses the source TABLE, including after proxy-graphics replay authorization. This overload passes allowExtensionDictionary=false and intentionally rejects a nonzero xDictHandle.
observations.comparison: A scratch copy with proxy replay authorized and xDictHandle cleared encodes successfully to 18,212 body bits and 128 handle bits.
observations.interpretation: The comparison isolates the direct-overload extension-handle gate. Clearing the handle loses a required graph edge and is not valid source output. The private extension-aware overload used by the DWG writer was not called directly; no extension dictionary descendants were staged, and no whole-file output/readback was qualified.

validation.result: Build passed. The selector now exits 0 only when the one-table AC1018 source has a nonzero extension handle, direct encoding refuses even after proxy authorization, and the no-extension comparison encodes. A repeat run exited 0.

remaining: Exercise the normal extension-aware whole-writer route for this exact source only after source identity and descendant graph binding are complete.
Prove destination rollback, corrected retry and fresh whole-file readback without dropping xDictHandle 0xBB.
Keep native rendering, independent cell semantics, producer breadth and support claims unqualified.
